name: Fügenerhof
beschreibung: The Apart Resort Fügenerhof of the Kröll family is located on the edge of the village centre of Fügen in the Zillertal, the largest village of the lower Zillertal. The house offers apartments for 3 to 8 people as well as the new “Almdorf Chalets” and the “Bergjuwel” apartment with sauna. All accommodations meet a minimum standard of 4 apartment stars and combine a modern country-house atmosphere with Tyrolean cosiness. As part of the “First Holiday Region in the Zillertal”, Fügen is an ideal starting point for an active holiday in the mountains – in summer for hiking and golfing, in winter for skiing. The holiday region is advertised as the “Most Active Valley in the World”. Guests can easily reach the village centre as well as the surrounding ski areas.
